interactions.overview: Wellby explains his sudden arrival to the captain and offers to help the Wave Dancer escape its pursuers.

introduction.quote: curly white hair! Um standing steady holding the rail. Um watching the wind and the sails easy on her feet as the ship rocks on the swells.

interactions.overview: The captain introduces Wellby to Pearl, who accepts his offer to help defend the ship.

introduction.quote: a stout like buff, tall for a halfling woman comes over wearing leather armor, a rapier at her side.

interactions.overview: Wellby sees Baxter standing on the deck and asks for help finding a place for him below.
A sailor helps Wellby stable Baxter, explains the ship’s dragonhide trade, and recommends Corrin for a map.

introduction.quote: one of the sailors comes over and helps you get. Ah get Baxter stowed, so you get him settled.

interactions.overview: Wellby settles Baxter in the hold with a sailor’s help.
The sailor tells Wellby that Corrin could draw him a map once he is less busy.
Returning to the deck, Wellby finds the captain still there as the pirate ship closes in.
Wellby asks Pearl about the pirate ship’s defenses and prospects for negotiation before attempting aerial sabotage.
Wellby sees the captain watching the wind and sails as the pursuers approach at sunset.
Before flying off, Wellby asks the crew to care for Baxter if he does not return.
Wellby congratulates the navigator as he creates a fog bank to conceal their escape.

introduction.quote: middle aged tanned man with bright blond hair

interactions.overview: Wellby sees the captain nod to the navigator before he creates the fog bank.
Wella introduces herself and invites Wellby to share food and tell the story of his arrival.
The navigator sketches a map for Wellby and explains that the Eastern Isles move.
Wellby hears Rose play guitar while he eats and talks with Wella and the crew.

introduction.quote: Another uh older woman brings out her guitar. Ah! Who Wella introduces as her wife, Rose, eats, and then begins to play as you sit and talk

interactions.overview: Wellby hears Corrin report that there are no lights on the horizon.
Wellby discusses finding a route into the Feywild with Wella, who offers passage and shares stories of unusual crossings.
Wella tells Wellby that many kenku were enslaved by Cha’mutte while distinguishing Wahacha’s people from that lineage.
As they approach Wahacha, Wella tells Wellby that the quiet harbor seems unusual.
At the dock, Wella waves Wellby and Baxter over to meet Makha.
Makha welcomes Wellby, warns him about coastal raids, and explains that two kenku who might help him have been taken.

introduction.quote: white feathers around their face a a smallish yellowish beak.

interactions.overview: Wellby introduces Baxter to Makha and explains where the axe beak comes from.
Wellby learns that Skoda, who might help with his kenku armor, has been taken by raiders.
Wellby learns that Nahto was taken along with his partner Skoda.
Wellby follows Makha into the air, explaining the limits of his magical flight as they head for the high pinnacle.
From the overlook, Wellby questions Makha about the shipwrecks and agrees to meet other visitors to discuss a rescue.
Wellby learns that Skoda may understand his armor’s magic and could help him find a route home.
Wellby hears about Nahto’s long journey through the Eastern Isles and considers him a possible source of help reaching the Feywild.
Wellby follows Makha from the overlook to a village built into a canyon.
Makha treats Wellby to fried fish with spicy relish at a village food stall.
Wellby follows Makha back toward the harbor cliffs after lunch.
Makha directs Wellby toward an inn and arranges a meeting with other travelers the following morning.
Makha suggests that Wella or another halfling can help Wellby find the inn.

review_notes: Opening u0001–u0013 recaps the previous adventure’s departure and is explicitly excluded rather than creating duplicate encounters; this also avoids resolving the uncertain ASR name {{Phoeba}} from a recap fragment.
The unnamed sailor in the hold is retained as a specific conversational partner; no name or identity link to another crew member is invented.
Excluded generic pirates (including the crow’s-nest combatant), unnamed crew/crowds, masked wizards as a group, generic monsters and hypothetical creatures. Their scenes remain available.
The session note and manifest place arrival on 1748-10-12, but u0944–u0947 says eleven days since departure on September 30. October 12 is retained as the documented date, pending chronology review.
Pre-lunch timing at Wahacha is relative to the explicit lunch at u1204; no exact arrival hour is asserted.
Pearl Brightmoon is the first mate; Corrin Wildheart is the navigator. Canonical surnames are identity metadata, not claims that Wellby heard them spoken in these passages.
Baxter’s dock record is mentioned: Wellby discusses his present companion with Makha, without directly acting on Baxter. Mentioned never means definitely absent.
Some apparent NPC dialogue is labeled Wellby in the source (for example u1041 and u1171); excerpts preserve those labels and summaries rely on the surrounding exchange and session note.
Rose is observed, not assumed to have conversed with Wellby simply because she is introduced and performs music.
No next-morning scene is invented: the session ends while arranging that future meeting. No individual crew member is credited with language lessons in the voyage montage.
Scene indexes belong to this extraction; canonical note hashes are included for identity resolution, but hidden/future lore from those notes is not included in interactions.
